name: Piper PA-46 Malibu / Mirage / Meridian / M-series
summary: Pressurized six-seat single built in both piston (Malibu, Mirage, M350) and PT6A turboprop (Meridian, M500, M600, M700) forms.

engines: Single engine: flat-six piston with a short nose and two- or three-blade prop, or PT6A turboprop with a longer nose, exhaust stacks and four-blade prop
fuselage: Slim fuselage with a few small windows and a split airstair door at left rear

tellTales: Long slender wing on a slim low-wing single
Conventional low tail with a modestly swept fin
Small pressurized cabin with only a few small windows

confusedWith.howToTell: The PA-46 has a slimmer fuselage and a long, slender wing without winglets; the TBM is larger and stouter with a shorter tapered wing and (on the 900 and later) winglets.
The PA-46 is much smaller with a low tail; the PC-12 has a T-tail and winglets.
The PA-46 is pressurized with a few small windows and a longer slimmer wing; the Bonanza A36 has larger windows and a shorter, broader wing.
The PA-46 has retractable gear and a pressurized slim cabin; the Cirrus SR has fixed gear and gull-wing doors.

usCount.source: Piper production (~3,000+ PA-46 piston and turboprop) with ~65% US-registered per FAA registry (approx.)
